name: hcapp_setDirectoryVisibility
description: Records who may find the caller in hasher search (E9.F1.S26) — the answer to the once-only question, or a change made in Settings. Writes HC.Hasher.DirectoryVisibility ALONE and never updatedAt: the column is not synced, so changing it must not make every phone re-download this hasher (James, 2026-10-02); no Hasher trigger stamps the row for this column. Auth: device-bound token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 142, @param NULL); the caller's own row only, no permission gate. Not transacted (a single UPDATE).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then fails gracefully).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Low two bits: 0 nobody, 1 people I have run with, 2 members of a kennel I belong to, 3 anyone; +16 also findable by real name. Default NULL, but NULL, a negative value or any bit outside 0x13 is refused with 14200. When the scope is 0 the real-name flag is dropped (stored as 0): nobody means nobody. The column itself is NULL until the question has been answered — this SP cannot set it back to NULL.

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) returns the error detail ALONE at index 0 — no envelope. Other failures return {success:0, errorCode, errorType} at index 0 then this detail at index 1: 14200 'Bad setting' (errorType 2, logged), 14201 unhandled (errorType 5, CATCH, logged).

rowsets.name: Visibility
rowsets.description: On success: the value now stored, re-read from the row.

columns.name: DirectoryVisibility
columns.description: Hasher.DirectoryVisibility after the write (the real-name flag already dropped for scope 0).

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher SET DirectoryVisibility = @visibility WHERE id = @userId (line 60) — no updatedAt change, deliberately.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on refusal (line 49) and in the CATCH (line 68).
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
